role: Directional optimization guidance; correctness and per-action reference wins gate scene expansion, without implying general engine superiority.

ideal.status: engineering hypothesis, not a proven lower bound
ideal.scope: Plectron evaluation + publication + preparation, excluding GPU completion, readback and PNG encoding
ideal.formula: CPU estimate = affected semantic work + layout/shaping work + changed publication + visible preparation. Native total = CPU + completion. Capture ready additionally includes readback, encoding and adapter overhead.
ideal.application: Validate the dependency topology before reducing a range. Parallel CPU/GPU durations cannot be added unless they are sequential in the measured path.

priority: preserve shared decode and texture reuse

interpretation.chromium: TaskDuration is an observed main-thread work reference that includes protocol-related work; it is not pure CPU time, native GPU completion or an interchangeable upper bound for Plectron total.
interpretation.interval: Use ideal estimates and Chromium observations to rank unexplained costs within each scenario. Do not treat their numerical interval as a mathematically proven performance envelope.
interpretation.capture: Both adapters obtain an actual encoded PNG. Native steady reuses a retained image; Chromium requests a fresh screenshot. Capture timing includes different transport, scheduling and encoding costs, so ratio remains null.
interpretation.geometry: Cards, layers, desk, isolation and list require exact selected rectangles, count, scroll and extent. Article and gallery compare content box dimensions, region and scroll while reporting non-collapsing vertical flow and gallery integer-pixel image quantization as explicit variations.
interpretation.sampling: Normalized cards (384), layers (512), article (96), gallery (128), desk (512), isolation (512) and list (512), 20 runs after three warmups per engine; each action wins against two Chromium batches. Desk, isolation and list use 64px demand overscan and the bounded 32-item sequence cache. List proves fixed clipped boxes as inferred fragment boundaries; isolation declares the same locality explicitly. Provisional directional observations, not confidence intervals or proof of engine superiority.
interpretation.next: Expand the target set with an orthogonal text-heavy mutation scene that combines multilingual shaping, wrapping and width changes without adding a new semantic model. Preserve the current rule that every action in certified scenes must remain below both Chromium TaskDuration references before further expansion.
interpretation.gate: Correctness, lifecycle and scenario-specific geometry are hard checks. Scene expansion additionally requires lower Plectron CPU than Chromium TaskDuration for every action in both reference batches. This remains directional evidence rather than a general browser-performance claim.
